kind: rigid weapon (AGENTS.md: rigid items are placed by anchor with integer offsets)
status: approved by user 2026-10-19 (kusarigama: kama with chain and weight; idle: S blade points at the viewer as a 1 px line, chain through the off hand, weight twirled one turn per loop; Sickle Strike (oneHandHeavy): weight twirled two turns around the off hand). The tanto stays for the Kyoketsu-Shoge stance, stabs and throws
construction: band: a straight band along the weapon axis from the grip point (the centre of the near fist); every pixel takes its colour from the cross-section pattern (back/spine to front/edge) of the segment it falls in, so the weapon keeps its thickness at any angle; pixels are rasterised from the authored data, never rotated or resampled from an image; the sickle blade is two branch segments (character-weapon.mjs branch: own axis from a point on the handle, turned from the handle axis toward +v), the second bent further in so the blade curves back toward the handle; the chain and weight hang from the butt cap in screen space (character-weapon.mjs chain), not along the weapon axis
paletteSource: colours already in the approved male clothing layers: #adadad armour grey (blade steel, guard, pommel), #ffffff armour/Gi white (edge), #3b2014 Gi shoe brown (hilt wrap), #a9977d Gi trouser shade (hilt diamonds), #ddcdb4 Gi trouser mid (blade collar); the wooden handle uses the locked skin-ramp shadow and dark (#9e4a31, #70241d) as wood, with the shoe brown (#3b2014) butt cap
units: pixels along the axis from the grip point (u, positive toward the tip) and across it (v)
outline: every coloured pixel touching empty space gets an outline pixel (#) if it is not already one
grip: one-handed sickle held at the lower handle: the fist covers u -2.5 to 2.5, the butt cap shows below it, the handle runs 9 px past the fist to an iron collar, and the blade leaves the collar at nearly a right angle on the +v side (the inner edge, white, faces the handle)

trail.rule: swing smear colours, from the blade tip inward (pixels from the outer edge): colours already in the approved palette (Gi/armour white, body wrap grey, armour grey); hard alpha

chain.rule: kusarigama (Christopher 2026-10-19: the kama has a chain with a weight at the end): the chain leaves the butt cap and hangs in screen space with gravity at any blade angle; a pose may set chain.to (weight offset), chain.sag and chain.z
